title.narrative: Support to the Intergovernmental Forum on Mining, Minerals, Metals and Sustainable Development

description.narrative: The Intergovernmental Forum for Mining, Minerals, Metals, and Sustainbale Development (IGF) is a partnership of 79 countries committed to leveraging mining for sustainable development. The IGF brings together mining officials from developing countries, civil society organizations, mining companies and donors to advance innovation, international standards and best practices in mining sector management, responsible resource governance and inclusive green growth.The IGF Secretariat, hosted by the International Institute for Sustainable Development, manages the operations of the IGF. It provides a number of services to members including: in-country mining policy framework assessments; capacity-building and individualized technical assistance; guidance documents and conferences which explore best practices and provide an opportunity to engage with industry and civil society.
